name: Silent Notice
source:
You are a transfer student of X Highschool, starting 12th grade, where you meet 5 wonderful women, one of which you share a dorm with.  Does love occur or is their a fatal ending?

[From [url=https://chuirii.itch.io/silent-notice] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是X高中的转学生，即将开始12年级。在那里，你遇见五位出色女性，其中一人与你住在同一间宿舍。爱情会发生吗？还是会迎来致命结局？

（来源：[url=https://chuirii.itch.io/silent-notice]itch.io[/url]）
